notes: Space-saving chromatic tuner with a shortened footprint, high-brightness display and DC OUT.

name: TU-3W Chromatic Tuner
notes: Waza Craft chromatic tuner with switchable buffered/true bypass, bypass output and DC OUT.

name: TW-1 T-Wah
notes: Envelope-controlled T-wah with SENS and PEAK knobs and a DRIVE up/down switch; usable with guitar, bass and electronic piano.

name: VB-2 Vibrato
notes: Vintage BBD vibrato with RATE, DEPTH, RISE TIME and MODE (LATCH/BYPASS/UNLATCH) controls.

name: VB-2W Vibrato
notes: Waza Craft BBD vibrato with RATE, DEPTH, RISE TIME and MODE knobs, Standard/Custom switch and DEPTH expression jack.

name: VE-20 Vocal Performer
notes: Vocal performer with harmony/pitch correction, reverb, 3-band EQ, distortion and a 38-second phrase loop.

name: VE-22 Vocal Performer
notes: Vocal performer with 39 effect types, harmony, pitch correction, color LCD, 37-second loop and USB audio/MIDI.

name: VE-500 Vocal Performer
notes: Vocal performer with harmony, pitch correction, reverb, delay, EQ, compressor, MIDI and USB audio/MIDI.

name: VE-8 Acoustic Singer
notes: Acoustic singer processor for voice and guitar with harmony, acoustic resonance, effects, 80-second loop and USB audio/MIDI.

name: VG-800 V-Guitar Processor
notes: V-Guitar processor with GK input, amp/cab modeling, synth and 150 guitar + 150 bass memories; over 150 effect types.

name: VO-1 Vocoder
notes: Compact vocoder with four modes (Advanced, Vintage, Talk Box, Choir), XLR mic input and SEND/RETURN loop.

name: WL-50 Wireless System
notes: Pedalboard wireless system: 7.2 x 12.1 cm receiver, WL-T transmitter, cable-tone simulation and 2.3 ms latency.

name: WL-60 Wireless System
notes: Wireless system with a pedalboard receiver, graphic LCD, automatic channel scan and WL-60T transmitter.

name: WP-20G Wave Processor
notes: GK-effect wave processor with six synth waves (Saw Lead, Square, Ring Mod, Slow Gear, Sitar, Acoustic) and 11 chorus/delay effects.

name: XS-1 Poly Shifter
notes: Compact polyphonic pitch shifter with BALANCE and SHIFT knobs, pedal-mode/direction switches and CTL/EXP jack.

name: XS-100 Poly Shifter
notes: Poly shifters with onboard EXP pedal, 30 memories, stereo outputs, MIDI and USB; 24-bit/48 kHz processing.

name: 3 Series Screamer
notes: JHS 3 Series Screamer — Tube Screamer-style overdrive with the JHS Strong Mod; Volume, Tone and Drive controls plus a +/- clipping toggle; true bypass; 9V DC, 12 mA.

name: Enzo
notes: Meris Enzo: multi-voice instrument synthesizer with Poly, Mono and Arp modes, 6-mode filter, ring modulation, tap delay and a dry-mode compressor; stereo TRS in/out, 9V DC at under 150 mA.

name: Enzo X
notes: Meris Enzo X: modular polyphonic instrument synthesizer with 5 synth modes, 6 voices, ADSR envelopes, MercuryX-derived reverbs, 2.5 s stereo delay, drives and modulation, all in a double-width enclosure with DIN MIDI and USB-C.

name: Hedra
notes: Meris Hedra: 3-voice rhythmic pitch shifter with chromatic or key-based harmony, per-voice time divisions, 4 delay matrices and glide/pitch-correction modes; 9V DC, under 150 mA.

name: LVX
notes: Meris LVX: modular stereo delay system with 2540 ms of configurable dual delay, a 60-second true stereo looper, modular processing elements (preamps, pitch, filter, cassette, granulize) and full DIN MIDI; 9V DC, 300 mA.

name: Mercury7
notes: Meris Mercury7: Blade Runner-inspired algorithmic reverb with Ultraplate and Cathedra algorithms, intra-tank pitch vector, modulation matrix and auto swell; stereo TRS I/O, 9V DC under 150 mA.

name: MercuryX
notes: Meris MercuryX: modular studio-grade reverb system with 8 custom structures (Ultraplate, Cathedra, 78 Room/Plate/Hall, Spring, Prism, Gravity), 2.54 s stereo predelay, freeze and modulation elements; DIN MIDI plus USB-C.

name: MIDI I/O
notes: Meris MIDI I/O: DIN MIDI to TRS-MIDI interface that gives up to four Meris pedals full MIDI control, preset storage and bidirectional communication; 9V DC, 10 mA.

name: Ottobit Jr.
notes: Meris Ottobit Jr.: arcade-inspired degradation pedal combining variable sample-rate/bit-depth crushing, a resonant low-pass filter, triggered stutter and a pitch/filter/decimation step sequencer; 9V DC under 150 mA.

name: Ottobit X
notes: Meris Ottobit X: full-stereo '80s-inspired modular degradation engine with advanced bitcrusher, six glitch types, two one-button loopers, tape stop, VHS delay/reverb, pitch, filter, mod and preamp categories; DIN MIDI plus USB-C.

name: Polymoon
notes: Meris Polymoon: super-modulated multi-tap delay with a 1200 ms delay line, six LFOs, tilt EQ in the feedback path, stereo barberpole phaser and dynamic flanger; 9V DC under 150 mA.

name: 019 UK Gold PLX
notes: Faithful recreation of a 1967 50 W British Plexi with dual channels and cab sim.

name: 020 Blueno
notes: Dual-channel preamp sampled from a hand-built 36 W Class A boutique amp.

name: A7
notes: New Micro ambience reverb with seven algorithms, infinite trail, per-mode presets and USB firmware updates.

name: Acoustikar
notes: Acoustic-guitar simulator with Piezo, Standard and Jumbo modes, level and body controls.

name: Ana Echo
notes: Fully analog delay with 20–300 ms delay time, echo/intense/rate controls and true bypass.

name: Audiofile
notes: Analog Class A pedalboard headphone amplifier and buffer with stereo/mono output and cab sim.

name: Baby Bomb
notes: 30 W micro power-amp pedal for 8–16 Ω cabinets with master and warm/bright controls.

name: @Wah
notes: Auto/Touch wah with LP, BP, HP, SP and Talk modes plus Range and Speed/Gain controls.

name: Bitmap
notes: Original Bitmap bitcrusher: fractional bit reduction from 24 bits down to 1 bit, sample-rate reduction and sample-rate modulation with triangle, square and random waveforms, plus a blend control and expression/CV control of the sample rate. Mono, true bypass, 9 V DC.

name: Bitmap 2
notes: Bitmap 2 expands the original bitcrusher with waveshaping, wavefolding and a window comparator, fractional bit reduction from 24 bits to 1 bit, sample-rate reduction from 48 kHz to 110 Hz and sample-rate modulation. Stereo TRS I/O, presets, expression/remote control and USB/TRS MIDI.

name: Buffer
notes: Compact always-on buffer using a low-noise Burr-Brown op amp, intended to prevent high-frequency loss at the start of a long pedal chain or before a long cable run. Mono, 9-18 V DC, no footswitch.

name: Context
notes: First-generation Context reverb with six algorithms (room, hall, cathedral, gated, plate and delay-plus-reverb), separate high/low damping, pre-delay and an internal trails switch. Mono, true bypass with trails off, expression/CV control.

name: Context 2
notes: Context 2 is a stereo reverb and delay with eight algorithms including room, hall, cathedral, gated, reverse, plate, spring and granular reverb. Each algorithm has low/high damping, pre-delay, modulation, dynamics, infinite hold and a switchable delay; spring mode adds tremolo.

name: Mixer
notes: Small always-on two-input mono mixer for pedalboards: combine instruments into one amp, sum parallel effect chains, or create a clean analog dry blend. Each input has its own level control; 9-18 V DC.

name: Particle
notes: The original Particle granular delay/pitch shifter, released in 2011. It slices the input into 15-250 ms grains and rearranges or pitch-shifts them across eight modes, with freeze, expression/CV control, true bypass and a fully analog dry path.

name: Particle V2
notes: Particle 2 is a stereo granular delay and pitch shifter with five delay modes and three pitch modes, +/-1 octave shifting, 0-2.5 s delay, adjustable grain size/density, freeze, presets and full MIDI control. It adds stereo I/O, higher fidelity and a smaller enclosure over the original.

name: Radius
notes: Radius is a stereo ring modulator and frequency shifter built on an eight-quadrant multiplier algorithm, with continuous blending between ring mod and frequency shifting, selectable 2x upper/lower sidebands, pitch tracking, a push-to-tune carrier and a multi-waveform LFO/step sequencer. MIDI-playable carrier, 96 kHz processing and expression/MIDI control.

name: Raster
notes: Original Raster: a digital delay with a pitch/phase/frequency shifter in the feedback loop, up to 750 ms delay, three shift modes and three feedback types. Mono, true bypass, expression/CV control; the later Raster 2 added stereo I/O, USB MIDI and a larger feature set.

name: Raster 2
notes: Raster 2 is a stereo digital delay with pitch and frequency shifting in the feedback loop: up to 1600 ms delay (3200 ms forward via the editor), +/-12 semitone shifting, detune and phase/frequency shifting, reverse delay, seven modulation waveforms, and series/parallel/ping-pong routing. MIDI clock, presets and a web editor.

name: RD-1 Pitch Delay
notes: RD-1 is a compact mono digital delay distilled from the Raster, adding three shift modes: chromatic +/-12 semitones, continuous detune from a fourth down to a major third up, and frequency shifting to +/-500 Hz. Delay runs to 1200 ms (2400 ms in reverse), with assignable expression/tap control and USB-C firmware updates. No MIDI or presets.

name: Remote 4
notes: Passive four-footswitch remote for Red Panda pedals, connected with a 1/4 in TRS cable. It provides four modes per host pedal for preset recall, bypass, tap tempo, hold/freeze and looper functions, with erasable scribble strips. No power required.

name: Tensor
notes: Tensor is a real-time time-warp pedal: reverse, tape stop/start, speed and pitch changes, time stretching from 1:4 to 4:1, and looping/overdub up to 9.4 s (4.7 s in stereo). It is always listening, supports momentary or latching footswitches, expression/remote control and USB/TRS MIDI.
